body:
Character select is live at https://csparty.example.com.

![join screen](/api/attachments/009ee084-0ab4-4d13-b0a0-927d762962db/content)

**How it works**
- The join screen shows a grid of the 8 characters, Mario Party style: T on the top row, CT on the bottom, and a Random tile underneath. Selecting a character shows its die faces and a one-line summary. These are the dice the plugin already gives each character, for example SEAL always rolls 3 or 4 and Guerilla rolls either 1 or 6.
- You can pick with the mouse, by tapping, with the arrow keys, or with a controller (D-pad or stick, then A to join). The page remembers your pick, and `?char=N` preselects one.
- The pick is sent to the server as `setinfo _csp_char N`, so CS 1.6 players can set it from the console too. When a match starts, picks are given out first come, first served in seat order. Bots, and anyone whose pick was already taken, get a random character from the ones left (that player also gets a chat message saying so). Before this change everyone was shuffled at random.

**Research:** your original ask was a pick screen like Mario Party's. The plugin already had 8 characters, each with its own die (`SKIN_*`), but handed them out at random at match start. So this change adds the grid and makes the server honour the pick. I drew original badges for the characters instead of using Valve's class portraits, because those are part of the key-protected game data.

**Tests**
- Join-page test in headless Chromium: 15/15 passed. It covers the 9 tiles, the die info panel, grid moves with the arrow keys including wrap-around and the Random row, `+setinfo _csp_char 2` being passed to the engine, the pick being remembered after a reload, Random sending no `_csp_char`, `?char=`, tap selection, no horizontal overflow on a portrait phone, and no page errors.
- Live end to end on game-host with the real browser client and bots, run twice:
  - Picked SEAL Team 6. Server log: `CharTest plays SEAL Team 6.`
  - Picked Elite Crew. Server log: `CharTest plays Elite Crew.`
- The plugin compiles, with the same single warning the old code already had.

**Deploy**
- Images `cs-party-server:0.4.5` and `cs-party-relay:0.4.2` are built on top of 0.4.4 and 0.4.1, and `csparty-up.sh` now uses the new tags. Both containers are healthy, and the server was restarted clean after the tests.
- Source changes are in `appdata/cs-party/src/cs-party`: `plugin/cs_party.sma`, `web/public/{index.html,boot.js}`, and a new README line. Each changed file has a `*.pre-ISSUE` backup.
- **Not done:** the Nextcloud copy of the repo is not synced.

**Limits**
- The grid doesn't show which characters other players have already picked, because the join page can't see the server before you connect. If two people pick the same character, the second gets a random one.
- A pick made after the match has started doesn't change your character until the next match.
